svg.aria-label: Seeing is the hard part. Given every position, gpt-6.1-sol finishes 36 of 36 tasks and 0.3% of its grasps fail; from sharp pictures with its own code, 28 and 23%; from pictures of 128 × 80, 14 and 41%; with no code, 13 and 31%. The same spot of one camera picture at 1280 × 800 and at 128 × 80: one pixel at 128 × 80 is about 14.5 mm, more than twice the 6 mm a cube may be off
